parts.text:
The SQL query you provided does not account for the non-natural modulation condition specified in the NTM classification system. Here is the corrected SQL query:

```sql
SELECT
    signalregistry AS signal_identifier,
    centerfreqmhz AS central_frequency,
    freqdrifthzs AS drift_rate,
    bwhz / centerfreqmhz AS bandwidth_ratio,
    CASE
        WHEN (bwhz / centerfreqmhz) < 0.0001 AND freqdrifthzs < 0.1 AND modtype != 'Unknown' THEN 'Strong NTM'
        WHEN (bwhz / centerfreqmhz) < 0.0005 AND freqdrifthzs < 0.5 AND modtype != 'Unknown' THEN 'Moderate NTM'
        ELSE 'Not NTM'
    END AS ntm_classification
FROM
    signals
WHERE
    signalclass = 'Narrowband';
```

This query filters signals based on their classification as 'Narrowband' and applies the NTM classification logic, including the check for non-natural modulation (modtype != 'Unknown').
